text:
kim_z: Quick SEO ops sync for launch posts + webinar. Need anchor-text plan, redirect rules (trailing slash + old permalinks), schema for speaker bios, and UTM -> SFDC mapping. Keep it tight.
rafael_p: I can take redirect CSV and run a link equity check afterward. Will ensure we preserve query strings for UTM.
jenny_t: I'll map internal anchors. Proposal: use keyword-focused anchors on resource hub, but keep one natural brand anchor per doc to avoid over-optimization.
priya_s: For lead routing: proposed UTMs: utm_source=organic_social|partner_email, utm_medium=social|email, utm_campaign=launch_q2_webinar. SFDC campaign = "Launch Q2 2026". Also add hidden field original_landing to form.
seo-bot: Recommended check: after redirects deploy, run a crawl for redirect chains and verify rel=canonical on top-tier pages. /tools/redirect-check?site=redwood.dev
rafael_p: Redirect examples (CSV snippet):
```
from,to,status
/old-posts/llm-economics,/resources/launch/llm-economics,301
/blog/benchmarks-2020,/resources/launch/benchmarks,301
/events/register,/events/launch-2026/register,302
/benchmarks,/resources/launch/benchmarks/,301
```
kim_z: Note: keep /benchmarks canonical at /resources/launch/benchmarks (no trailing slash canonical). Also set up server rule to strip duplicate trailing-slash variants.
jenny_t: Anchor plan (high level):
- link phrase "LLM inference cost" -> /resources/launch/llm-economics
- link phrase "inference benchmarks" -> /resources/launch/benchmarks
- from docs/serving-runtime use contextual anchor to benchmarks article
Prioritize pages with >200 sessions/mo and highest conversion velocity.
priya_s: GTM & SFDC mapping: publish mapping doc with these fields: utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, webinar_id, landing_page. Map webinar_id to CampaignMember and landing_page to Lead.Source_Detail. I'll post the spreadsheet.
seo-bot: Schema tip: include Speaker as Person with sameAs links and JobTitle. Consider FAQPage + Event schema combo on landing.
kim_z: Draft speaker JSON-LD (short):
```
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Person","name":"Leah M.","jobTitle":"Head of Product","sameAs":["https://www.linkedin.com/in/leahm"]}
```
rafael_p: Also include Event schema on the landing and use publicationDate on posts for clarity. If gated, add Offer block.
jenny_t: Internal link rollout plan: create a ticket to add hub banner on product and docs pages, batch updates in PRs of 25 pages to avoid churn. Track clicks via data-layer event "hub_click".
priya_s: Important: when switching /events/register from 302 -> 301 post-event, run a traffic reconciliation against UTMs and update SFDC records where campaign attribution missed.
kim_z: Owners: redirects -> @rafael_p, anchor/internal links -> @jenny_t, UTMs/SFDC -> @priya_s, schema -> @kim_z. Publish owner = growth-marketing.
rafael_p: I'll open GH PR with redirects CSV and a one-line rollout SOP. ETA: Thu AM.
jenny_t: I'll push anchor list + PR split plan by Wed.
priya_s: I'll share GTM QA steps and SFDC mapping doc by tomorrow morning.
seo-bot: Scheduled checks: staging crawl 2026-04-18T08:00Z; post-publish redirect/canonical audit 2026-04-22T09:00Z.
kim_z: Sweet. Keep PR links in this thread. Short follow-ups only. :white_check_mark:
